text: Reproduced original defect in headless R: native CPU lookup received two_sided and discarded half of positive/negative palettes. Added overlay_tail with explicit overrides and effective-limit inference; generated plot_brain.Rd. Full suite running with RGL_USE_NULL=true and NOT_CRAN=false to skip network/slow fixtures. Logs: /private/tmp/neuroatlas-52-before-headless.log and /private/tmp/neuroatlas-52-suite.log.
